title: Fix flaky AgentOperator durable usage budget tests
body:
Fix flaky AgentOperator durable usage budget tests by ensuring `tool_a` finishes and caches its result before `tool_b` fails. Parallel execution could cancel `tool_a` before caching, causing retries to execute both tools unexpectedly.

- CI job: https://github.com/apache/airflow/actions/runs/36766643472/job/110074317098

files.patch:
@@ -28,7 +28,7 @@
 
 import pytest
 from pydantic import BaseModel
-from pydantic_ai import Agent, DeferredToolRequests
+from pydantic_ai import Agent, DeferredToolRequests, Tool
 from pydantic_ai.capabilities import Toolset
 from pydantic_ai.exceptions import UsageLimitExceeded
 from pydantic_ai.messages import (
@@ -2884,7 +2884,9 @@ def tool_b() -> str:
             self.live_tool_calls += 1
             return "B"
 
-        return FunctionToolset(tools=[tool_a, tool_b])
+        # Cache tool_a before tool_b fails; sibling cancellation in a parallel batch
+        # can otherwise prevent the successful result from being persisted.
+        return FunctionToolset(tools=[Tool(tool_a, sequential=True), tool_b])
 
     def run_attempt(
         self, *, max_tries=0, prompt="run", limits=None, fail_after_run=False, interrupt_at_step=None
